label: prose:outro-fluid-dynamics
title: Chapter close — Fluid Dynamics of the Brane
html:
This chapter recasts the q-deformed Navier–Stokes system as a structural framework for the Clay Millennium Problem. The classical q \to 1 limit is a degeneration of a regular categorical system.

The next chapter (Stochastic Mechanics) develops the Markov-trace transition dynamics on the same categorical state space, connecting the q-shell hierarchy and classical-limit degeneration to Nelson-type stochastic processes and adelic q \to 1 limits.
